race.comment: POPTHEBUBBLY (9) sets the standard after going under by only half a length at Hamilton, where she was sent out favourite and was only collared late. Her Bendigo seventh prior was also sound enough, beaten just under three lengths, and this looks a nice option. TOO MUCH TOO SOON (10) is the fresh runner with upside if ready; she ended last preparation with two Class 1 runs that read below her best, but she draws low and should run well. ARABIAN MYTH (3) is in the right vein of form after consecutive Mornington thirds and backs up quickly with a 2kg claim, so he looks a genuine winning danger if he holds that level. DUBAI FOUNTAIN (8) resumed with a three-length Class 2 win at Berrigan. This is harder but she looks to have come back well. TRUE PROPHET (2) is very consistent and looks a key hope again.
